label: D2 arrival at S1 via a1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when the reached state shown is S1 (99.98% of mass; in_action a1 is 97% of mass, so mostly common a1->S1). Within that, it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward 0 has 90% of mass) and it rises steeply with episode time: nothing before trial ~50, and 58% of mass in trials 90-99. It is weaker at low model value. Magnitude grows over runs of consecutive unrewarded S1 visits (top windows show 0.24 -> 0.72 -> 1.00 across repeated a1/S1c/r0 trials), and it drops to small values after a rare S1 arrival. It does not fire at D1 or GO, on S2 arrivals, or after rewarded trials (prev_reward 1 has 10% of mass). All variables are observed at D2. The ep_trial threshold is a crude stand-in for a gradual drift with episode time, so precision tops out around 0.6 (dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.85). Dropping action==1 gives F1 0.60.
